candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations, which order propagates as 502 on /v1/orders and gateway surfaces as 502 on /v1/checkout. Traces show inventory/reservations succeeding (200) and the failure originating at the payment call.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side traces/logs/metrics were excluded from context, so the internal payment fault (e.g. 5xx origin) is inferred from caller-side 503 only.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout 502s are fast (~50-60ms) and trace to order returning 502, which traces to payment returning 503 on /v1/authorizations while inventory reservations succeed. This bounds the fault to the payment authorization path. Payment-side evidence was excluded, so the specific payment failure mode is unconfirmed.
